blocks.text: 发现该漏洞的 AI 安全公司 Calif 在一份声明中表示，如果不尽快修补，这些漏洞可能使全球 70% 的网站面临风险，并称其为“AI 发现的最严重漏洞，甚至可能是整个软件史上最严重的漏洞”。

blocks.text: PHP 紧急发布了修复程序，因为这些漏洞可能让无账号的攻击者接管 Web 服务器。
两个漏洞在 CVSS 严重性评分中均为 9.2 分，影响低至 5.4 的 PHP 版本。
当请求在错误的时机触及 PHP 的内存上限时，PHP 会释放内存但保留指向该内存的指针，该工作进程上后续的请求便可劫持这块内存。
审计人员在 2024 年发现了这一弱点，但修复工作停滞了数月，部分原因是没有人展示过实际攻击。
现由 Google 拥有的云安全公司 Wiz 表示，这些模型让一名研究人员在一周内完成了过去顶尖团队需要数月才能完成的工作。
CVE 编号的泄露迫使 PHP 提前一天发布，Cloudflare 目前报告称已出现早期攻击尝试。
Researchers using GPT-5.6 Sol found massively critical flaw in PHP, which runs about 70% of websites, knocked major sites offline as operators rushed to patch.

blocks.text: Calif, an AI security firm, who found this, said in a statement that the vulnerabilities could put 70% of the world’s websites at risk if they aren’t patched quickly, and called them “the most severe vulnerabilities ever discovered by AI, if not in all of software history.”

blocks.text: PHP rushed out fixes as it could let attackers without accounts take over web servers.
Both bugs score 9.2 on the CVSS severity scale and affect PHP versions as old as 5.4.
When a request hits PHP’s memory cap at the wrong moment, PHP frees memory but keeps pointers to it, which a later request on that worker can hijack.
Auditors spotted the weakness in 2024, but the fix stalled for months, partly because nobody had shown a practical attack.
Wiz, a cloud security company, now owned by Google, says the models let one researcher finish in a week what once took a top team months.
A leak of the CVE numbers forced PHP to ship a day early, and Cloudflare now reports early attack attempts.
